verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a free, fully featured Sandbox that supports the whole API, including a Sandbox-only endpoint for creating test Items. It also offers a cloneable Quickstart app and code samples in its Node SDK, so developers can run examples against test data. However, nothing in the pack shows an interactive in-browser API reference or 'try it' console, and the OpenAPI probe found no public spec. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer within the reference docs, runnable examples embedded in the reference pages, a public OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
